item.title: Idol★Harem
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Ark Shell
  • 発売日: 2008-10-31
  • スコア: 6.21/10 (29 人評価)
  • 日本語名: アイドル★ハーレム
  • 英語名: Idol★Harem

あらすじ

I’m Yura. I have a twin older sister. She is a famous gravure idol, but she always teases me. One day, she suddenly calls and tells me to come to an island where she is now staying for her next photobook. When I arrive there, there is nothing wrong with her except for being suntanned. According to her, she called me to replace her since she got suntanned too much. “We are twins. There’ll be no problem.” “Well, I can’t…. Oh, please stop…!” Like this, I’ve now become a gravure idol though I’m a man….

あらすじ

Kurou is a good-looking guy. Many women approach him, and he enjoys it. But he gets sick of it, and starts to live stoically. Since then, his real older sister, Riho, starts to approach him, and they finally sleep together… That’s no good. They make love every night. But their parents find it, and he is kicked out of their house. On his first day at his new apartment, when he wakes up, he finds Riho giving him a blowjob…

item.title: Harem & Harem
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Ark Shell
  • 発売日: 2006-06-23
  • スコア: 7.209999999999999/10 (9 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ハーレム＆ハーレム
  • 英語名: Harem & Harem

あらすじ

One day, the main character’s father tells him “If you want to inherit my property, complete this test!”. He is given a small cafeteria and an apartment and gets out of his house. The condition to come back to his house is to run the cafeteria for one year and graduate his school at the same time. He is given money to run his cafeteria for a while but he needs to pay rent for his apartment, cafeteria and expenses. Also, he needs to hire waitresses by himself. The last condition given from his father is to find a woman who loves him regardless of money and power…

item.title: Tottemo Harem
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Ark Shell
  • 発売日: 2005-09-02
  • スコア: 7.090000000000001/10 (10 人評価)
  • 日本語名: とってもハーレム
  • 英語名: Tottemo Harem

あらすじ

Although our main character is an infamous slacker due to not having any extracurricular activities after classes or a part-time job; he’s going to have his hands full with a few ways than one. His father is the complete antithesis of him, a man married to his work–which is why the mother left the family. Yet somehow the over-working, non-feeling father bags another wife (who happens to have a daughter of her own). By matters not completely apparent to White Masq; our hero begins to pursue all his crushes and infatuations in both school and at home to build a harem. Perhaps because they all seem to work, he’s trying to leech off of them all? If that is the case, he’s found a way to compensate them!
